instagram:
Why are my Facebook ads not reaching anyone? Paise kate, ad chala nahi, ek bhi customer nahi aaya. Teen wajah hoti hain, aur teesri koi nahi batata. 📉

1. Review ya reject: Ads Manager kholiye, Delivery column dekhiye. Wahan saaf likha hota hai in review ya rejected. Reject hua to wajah padhiye, ad theek kijiye, phir se bhejiye.

2. Audience chhoti ya budget kam: sirf ek gali, ek umar, ek shauk chuna to ad dikhane ke liye log hi nahi milte. Poora shehar rakhiye, aur budget itna ki ad kuch din lagatar chal sake.

3. Payment fail: card expire ya UPI se paisa kata hi nahi, to ad chupchap ruk jaata hai. Billing mein jaakar payment method check kijiye.

Save kar lijiye, agla ad lagane se pehle kaam aayega. Comment mein bataiye, aapka ad kis wajah se ruka tha? 👇
